Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a business and occupation tax credit for certain mental health services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax credit for theprovision of certain mental health services; adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A credit is allowed against the tax due under this chapter toemployers for the cost of the provision of mental health servicespursuant to the passage of chapter . . . (Engrossed House Bill No. 1460or Substitute Senate Bill No. 5446), Laws of 2007 to employees. Thecredit is equal to the additional cost to the employer attributable tothe coverage of such services within an employer offered health benefitplan required by chapter . . . (Engrossed House Bill No. 1460 orSubstitute Senate Bill No. 5446), Laws of 2007.
